text: In the Vardi–Wolper automata-theoretic approach to LTL model checking, the negated formula is translated into a ___ automaton, an ω-automaton that accepts infinite words visiting an accepting state infinitely often.
explanation: A Büchi automaton is an ω-automaton on infinite words whose acceptance condition is 'some accepting state is visited infinitely often'. The product of the Kripke structure with the Büchi automaton for ¬φ is searched for an accepting (lasso) run, which would be a counterexample.
